title: Length bound for iterated guarded updates
statement: For any function $g$ from finite bit strings to finite bit strings, any finite bit string $w$, and any natural number $i$, the result of applying the guarded loop determined by $g$ exactly $i$ times to $w$ has length at most $7(|w|+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a function from finite bit strings to finite bit strings
